collapse_other_groups.description: Collapse all tab groups except the active one (Suggested: Alt+Shift+Up)

alt_switch_fast.description: Quick switch - Use to switch quickly among last 2 to 4 tabs. (Suggested: Alt+A)

number_1.description: Expand 1st tab group if all collapsed

number_2.description: Expand 2nd tab group if all collapsed

number_3.description: Expand 3rd tab group if all collapsed

number_4.description: Expand 4th tab group if all collapsed

number_5.description: Expand 5th tab group if all collapsed

number_6.description: Expand 6th tab group if all collapsed

number_7.description: Expand 7th tab group if all collapsed

number_8.description: Expand 8th tab group if all collapsed

number_9.description: Expand 9th tab group if all collapsed

select_tab_1.description: Go to tab 1 of the current group (alternative to Ctrl+1)

select_tab_2.description: Go to tab 2 of the current group (alternative to Ctrl+2)

select_tab_3.description: Go to tab 3 of the current group (alternative to Ctrl+3)

select_tab_4.description: Go to tab 4 of the current group (alternative to Ctrl+4)

select_tab_5.description: Go to tab 5 of the current group (alternative to Ctrl+5)

select_tab_6.description: Go to tab 6 of the current group (alternative to Ctrl+6)

select_tab_7.description: Go to tab 7 of the current group (alternative to Ctrl+7)

select_tab_8.description: Go to tab 8 of the current group (alternative to Ctrl+8)

select_tab_9.description: Go to the last tab of the current group (alternative to Ctrl+9)

closeRightTabsInGroup.description: Close tabs to the right in the current tab group (Suggested: Alt+Shift+R)

nextTab.description: Go to the next tab in the window (alternative to Ctrl+Tab)

previousTab.description: Go to the previous tab in the window (alternative to Ctrl+Shift+Tab)
